is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on major African malaria vectors including Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.l. (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Discusses kdr mutations (L1014F, L1014S) and Ace-1 G119S (Ace-1R) (page 6, Figure 3; page 7, 'Resistance mechanisms').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No primary extractable population-level genotype counts or frequencies linked to sample sizes are provided; data are presented only as aggregated review summaries and percentages across published studies (e.g., Figure 5, page 8).

african_field_population.evidence: The review covers field data collected across 54 countries in Africa (page 1, Abstract; page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a review and database/mapping platform introduction (IR Mapper) that compiles previously published literature and databases rather than reporting primary empirical field collections (page 1, Abstract; page 3, 'A systematic search of the published, peer-reviewed literature... was performed').

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific localities from literature are referenced and mapped within the IR Mapper tool (page 3, 'Data were extracted into Microsoft Excel 2010... locality name, GPS coordinates').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collection periods were documented down to specific collection years in the underlying review database (page 3, 'mosquito collection period').

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper is an explicit consolidation/re-analysis of published literature, IRBase/ANVR, and PMI reports (page 3, 'Methods').

supplement.evidence: Additional files 1-7 contain meta-summary tables of the reviewed literature, not primary field-level genotype records.

assessment.summary: This publication introduces the online tool IR Mapper (www.irmapper.com) and presents a systematic review/meta-synthesis of insecticide susceptibility and resistance mechanism data published between 1954 and 2012 across Africa. Because it is a review and does not present primary empirical genotype counts or frequencies for distinct field populations, it is not eligible.
exclusion_reasons: Study is a review and database presentation, not a primary empirical study.
Lacks extractable population-level genotype or allele counts/frequencies with sample size.
